title: NEB Class 11 Physics — Dynamics — 2021
subject: physics
source: NEB Grade 11 Model Questions / NEB Past Papers 2020-2024

questions.question: A block of mass 10 kg rests on a rough inclined plane of angle 30 degrees with the horizontal. If the coefficient of friction is 0.2, find the magnitude of the frictional force acting on the block.
questions.solution:
**Step 1 — Resolve the weight vertically and normally:**
$$N = mg\cos\theta = 10 \times 9.8 \times \cos 30^\circ = 98 \times 0.866$$
$$N = 84.87\ \text{N}$$

**Step 2 — Frictional force** (since the block rests, friction balances the downslope component):
$$F = \mu N = 0.2 \times 84.87$$
$$\boxed{F = \mathbf{16.97\ N} \approx \mathbf{17\ N}}$$

**Step 3 — Check:** The component of weight down the slope is
$$mg\sin 30^\circ = 10 \times 9.8 \times 0.5 = 49\ \text{N}$$
Since $49\ \text{N} > 17\ \text{N}$, friction is indeed sufficient to hold the block at rest, confirming the result.
questions.knowledgeNote: Friction equals mu times normal force, and on an incline the normal force equals mg cosine of the slope angle.
